Name: Chenaniah, Master of Song
Summary: Chief of the Levites for song, who instructed about the song because he was skilful.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:22; 1 Chronicles 15:27: Chief of the Levites for song, who instructed about the song because he was skilful.
LifeLesson: The mention of Chenaniah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
